# Brand assets

| File                 | Size       | Use                                             |
| -------------------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `banner.png`         | 1536 × 768 | README header                                   |
| `social-preview.png` | 1280 × 640 | Repository social preview (Settings → General)  |
| `avatar.png`         | 512 × 512  | Organization avatar / logo mark                 |

## Palette

The documentation site (`docs/index.html`) uses the same palette: rust orange as the primary
accent (`#D9480F` on hover) and verdigris for focus and the active state.

| Token        | Hex       |
| ------------ | --------- |
| Rust orange  | `#E8590C` |
| Verdigris    | `#12B886` |
| Charcoal     | `#0F1115` |
| Off-white    | `#F1F3F5` |
| Muted gray   | `#ADB5BD` |

## Provenance

Generated on 2026-11-03 with `gpt-image-2.5-flare` (via the Figma image generator), then
cropped/resized locally. Raster output; a hand-cleaned vector version of the mark is still to do.

**Avatar (1024 × 1024)**

> Minimal flat vector logo mark for an open-source Rust web framework called Oxide: a bold
> geometric hexagonal ring built from faceted crystal planes, smooth gradient from warm rust orange
> (#E8590C) on the upper left to oxidized-copper verdigris teal (#12B886) on the lower right,
> centered with generous padding on a solid deep charcoal background (#0F1115). No text, no
> letters. Clean sharp edges, subtle facet shading, square app icon, high contrast, modern
> developer-tool branding.

**Banner (generated 1536 × 864, cropped to 1536 × 768)**

> Wide GitHub README banner for an open-source Rust web framework named "Oxide". Solid deep
> charcoal background (#0F1115) with a very subtle dark hexagonal grid pattern fading toward the
> edges. On the left third: a flat vector logo mark, a bold geometric hexagonal ring built from
> faceted crystal planes with a gradient from warm rust orange (#E8590C) to oxidized-copper
> verdigris teal (#12B886). To its right, the wordmark "Oxide" in a large, clean, bold geometric
> sans-serif, off-white (#F1F3F5), and beneath it the tagline "Laravel-grade ergonomics.
> Compile-time safety." in a smaller light gray (#ADB5BD) sans-serif. Exact spelling of all text.
> Balanced composition, generous margins, modern minimal developer-tool branding, no other text,
> no people.
